title: Clay Studio Resident Internship
source_quote: The Clay Studio RI will work directly with Craigardan staff in the organization and execution of all studio processes, classes and workshops, kiln firings, and general studio maintenance.
evidence_sentence: The internship description states Clay Studio RIs learn electric, wood, and salt kiln prep, firing and maintenance while working 30 hours/week on studio operations.
evidence_quote: Electric, wood, and salt kiln prep, firing and maintenance
summary: A 12-week minimum internship for early-career ceramicists combining studio work (kiln prep, firing, materials management, teaching assistance) with free housing, a full fellowship ($2300/week value), and 10 hours/week personal studio time. Applications open September 15, ongoing until filled.
how_to_join: Apply at https://www.craigardan.org/internship-apply. Application opens September 15 and remains open until positions fill. Applicants are interviewed via Zoom. Requires BFA/BA in ceramics or apprenticeship equivalent, ability to lift 50 lbs, vehicle, and financial planning for 3+ months without income.
cost_text: Full fellowship provided ($2300/week value); no tuition cost. Interns responsible for transportation, personal tools, art materials, and some food beyond farm share.
pay_text: Full fellowship ($2300/week value) in exchange for 30 hours/week work; participants also receive housing, farm share, and free program access.
commitment: Minimum 12 weeks (3 months); typical commitment 3+ months with flexible focus areas (farm + clay, farm + culinary, or clay + culinary combinations available).
